== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Imperial Squad Leader (PC 2024 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with [[Imperial Squad Leader (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]]. The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2024 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>792b044b67de9ab7b16cce6b5bda0d58c42ea608</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
